islamic-university-madinah-scholarship-a.about:
The university's scholarship admission announcement for 1448 AH covers internal and external, full and partial scholarships at bachelor level. Full-scholarship applicants must not reside in Saudi Arabia. Applications are submitted through the Study in Saudi platform.

Applicants need a secondary certificate (science track for science colleges) earned within the last five years, must be 17 to 25, in good conduct, medically fit, with a police clearance and an endorsement from a recognised body or academic figure in their country, and must pass any tests or interviews. The Quran college requires full memorisation of the Quran. For partial scholarships weighting is certificate plus aptitude (and achievement test for sciences).

The page does not itemise what a full scholarship covers; see the Undergraduate Admission Guide for Scholarship Students linked on the admissions page.
islamic-university-madinah-scholarship-a.eligibility: International applicants (nationality restrictions not listed; Georgia and Qatar are not mentioned). Secondary certificate from the last 5 years, age 17-25, not resident in Saudi Arabia (full scholarship), good conduct, medical fitness, police clearance, endorsement letter, no prior scholarship from a Saudi institution, and passing tests/interviews.
how_to_apply: Create a profile on the Study in Saudi platform
Check the Undergraduate Admission Guide for Scholarship Students on the university admissions page
Apply during the announced window
Provide certificate, police clearance and endorsement
Sit tests or interviews if invited
islamic-university-madinah-scholarship-a.costs: Full and partial scholarships exist; the announcement does not itemise benefits. Consult the admission guide.

romanian-government-scholarships-non-eu-.about:
The Romanian state scholarship programme run through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is open to citizens of non-EU countries. It covers bachelor's (3 to 6 years), master's (1 to 2 years) and PhD (4 years) studies. Bachelor's and master's holders study in Romanian; students without Romanian take a preparatory language year unless they hold a B1 certificate, passed the Romanian test or had four years of Romanian schooling. PhD students may choose Romanian or a foreign language set by their doctoral school.

The official pages say state scholarships are paid in lei with amounts and numbers set by Government decision; personal expenses and international travel are not covered and dormitory accommodation is the student's responsibility. The official text does not state tuition coverage explicitly, so confirm in the call documents.

Applications go through the online portal in four steps: create an account, apply, get an answer, study in Romania. Candidates need an average of at least 7 (Romanian scale) or 'Good' in their last graduated school.
romanian-government-scholarships-non-eu-.eligibility: Citizens of non-EU countries; Georgia and Qatar are not mentioned on the official pages, so check the call. Excluded: ethnic Romanians abroad (separate programmes), people with protection status in Romania, diplomatic staff and families, and holders of a Romanian state scholarship for the same cycle. Needs a high-school diploma (bachelor), bachelor's degree (master) or master's (PhD) and an average of at least 7 on the Romanian scale or 'Good'.
how_to_apply: Open the official scholarship portal and create an account
Check the call for the 2027/28 academic year when published
Submit the online application with academic documents
Wait for the answer, then follow the placement and language-year instructions
romanian-government-scholarships-non-eu-.costs: State scholarship paid in Romanian lei (amount set by Government decision). International travel and personal expenses are not covered; dormitory accommodation is the student's responsibility. Tuition coverage is not stated on the pages checked.

cnio-summer-training-programme.about:
CNIO's Summer Training Programme gives undergraduates in their final years of biomedicine or life-sciences studies seven to eight weeks of practical training in a cancer research group. The number of places varies by year (4 in 2026).

The page does not state whether positions are paid and the 2027 call is not yet published, so check the page and contact the training office before planning.
cnio-summer-training-programme.eligibility: Undergraduates in their final years of biomedicine-related or life-sciences degrees in any country, so international applicants are eligible. Pay and the 2027 timetable are not stated; contact summertraining@cnio.es.
how_to_apply: Watch the CNIO undergraduate programmes page for the 2027 call
Contact summertraining@cnio.es for the application process and dates
Submit the application when the call opens
cnio-summer-training-programme.costs: The page does not say whether the programme is paid or what support is offered; confirm with summertraining@cnio.es.

hhmi-cech-fellows-summer-research-2027.about:
The Cech Fellows Program (formerly the Janelia summer undergraduate research route) gives undergraduates a summer in an HHMI laboratory at a US research university or at the Janelia Research Campus in Ashburn, Virginia. Fellows receive USD 15,000 at host institutions or USD 12,000 at Janelia with free on-campus housing.

Applicants must be enrolled full-time at an accredited US or US-territory institution and be lawfully permitted to take part through 12 August 2027 (US citizen, permanent resident, or holder of a valid visa/status). HHMI does not sponsor visas. This is therefore open to international students already studying in the US, not to students applying from abroad.
hhmi-cech-fellows-summer-research-2027.eligibility: Full-time students at an accredited US or US-territory institution who are lawfully permitted to participate through 12 August 2027 (US citizens, permanent residents, or international students with valid visa/status). HHMI does not sponsor visas or pay visa fees. Not open to students enrolled outside the US.
how_to_apply: Open the Cech Fellows programme page and read the 2027 details
Prepare the online application and recommendations
Submit by 17 December 2026, 5 pm ET
hhmi-cech-fellows-summer-research-2027.costs: Paid: USD 15,000 at host institutions (covers travel, housing, meals; you arrange housing) or USD 12,000 at Janelia including free on-campus housing.

max-planck-computer-science-research-int.about:
The Max Planck Institutes in Computer Science run a joint internship programme in which interns work with a mentor on a research project, usually for 12 to 14 weeks. Interns receive a monthly stipend, housing and round-trip travel.

Bachelor's, master's and doctoral students worldwide can apply, with roughly the first three years of a CS bachelor's completed, a strong record and professional English. German is not required. Selected interns get documents to support a German/Schengen visa application. Applications are accepted year-round but are competitive.
max-planck-computer-science-research-int.eligibility: Bachelor's, master's and doctoral students worldwide, with roughly the first three years of a CS bachelor's by the start date, a strong academic record and professional English. Applicants from abroad must apply for a German/Schengen visa themselves; support documents are provided.
how_to_apply: Prepare CV, transcripts (unofficial accepted) and one referee contact; motivation letter optional
Apply online at the internship application portal (not by email)
Apply by 1 November for summer starts, or at least 5 months before another start date
Results for summer applications come by 1 February
max-planck-computer-science-research-int.costs: Fully funded: monthly stipend, housing and round-trip travel. Visa fees may be waived for stays up to 3 months.

perimeter-institute-psi-start-undergradu.about:
PSI Start offers undergraduates planning graduate study in physics a two-week summer school at Perimeter Institute (about 30 students, 14-25 June 2027, no fee, with travel support, accommodation and food) and a paid in-person research internship of at least 12 weeks between 3 May and 20 August 2027. Interns are selected from the same application and also attend the June school.

Applicants should be in their second-to-last undergraduate year (or in their final year if they plan to start graduate school in 2028 or later) and know Lagrangian/Hamiltonian mechanics, basic quantum mechanics and linear algebra by the start. Applications are made once, online.
perimeter-institute-psi-start-undergradu.eligibility: Students around the world who meet the criteria may apply; no country restrictions are listed. Must be in the second-to-last undergraduate year (or final year, planning to start graduate studies in 2028 or later); students starting a physics graduate programme in 2027 generally cannot apply. International interns need a visitor visa and/or eTA.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility on the programme page and FAQ
Apply online through the academicjobsonline posting (job ID 33186) by 17 January 2027
Select the research internship option if you want it
Internship offers are made by end of February 2027
perimeter-institute-psi-start-undergradu.costs: Summer school: no fee, with travel support, accommodation and food. Internship: paid Research Award (amount not published), airfare and local transport, housing assistance and meal credit.

rockefeller-university-surf-2027.about:
The Chemers Neustein SURF Program places undergraduates in a Rockefeller University laboratory in New York City for ten weeks of full-time research (7 June to 13 August 2027). Participants receive a USD 6,500 stipend and free housing if they cannot commute.

College sophomores and juniors are eligible and the page states that international students may apply. Applications go through the online SURF application system; decisions are announced in mid-March 2027.
rockefeller-university-surf-2027.eligibility: College sophomores and juniors. International students may apply (the page states this). Visa and work-authorisation details are not given on the page; confirm with the programme.
how_to_apply: Open the SURF online application (surfapplication.rockefeller.edu)
Complete the application and request recommendations
Submit by 1 February 2027
Decisions are sent in mid-March 2027
rockefeller-university-surf-2027.costs: Paid: USD 6,500 stipend; free housing provided for students who cannot commute. No application fee stated.
